info.title: aexon
info.description: AI-powered CLI tool inspired by Claude Code

commands.name: llm
commands.description: # interactive picker for the default LLM provider

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Working directory for this session

options.name: --model
options.description: Main model or alias (sonnet / opus / haiku / gpt-4o / o3 / ...)

options.name: --provider
options.description: AI provider: anthropic, openai, or ollama (reads stored default when omitted)

options.name: --resume
options.description: Resume a specific session by id, directory, manifest, or transcript path

options.name: --continue
options.description: Resume the most recently updated session

options.name: --fork-session
options.description: Fork the resumed transcript into a brand new session

options.name: --settings
options.description: Load hooks and MCP servers from a specific settings.json file

options.name: --mcp-config
options.description: Alias for --settings

options.name: --print
options.description: Run a single non-interactive prompt and exit

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Non-interactive output format: text, markdown, or json

options.name: --approval-mode
options.description: Non-interactive permission policy: allow or deny (default)

options.name: --max-turns
options.description: Maximum assistant/tool turns for this run

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Anthropic and OpenAI traffic is always brokered through NyxID; configure provider
credentials in the NyxID UI first, then run `aexon login` and `aexon llm`.
Environment:
NYXID_BASE_URL     NyxID base URL for `aexon login` (default: https://nyx-api.chrono-ai.fun)
OLLAMA_HOST        Base URL for the local Ollama server (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)
OLLAMA_BASE_URL    Alias for OLLAMA_HOST
AEXON_CHAT_LOGGING Enable MEAI pipeline logging on the console (1/true)
